title: Elevated 500s on checkout-service after a tax/payment library deploy
root_cause: A new tax-calculation library version was deployed without a required config migration, causing null tax_rate lookups and NullPointerExceptions in PaymentValidator.charge().
recommended_action: Roll back checkout-service to the previous version. File a follow-up ticket to add the missing tax-rate config migration before re-deploying.

title: Database connection pool exhaustion on inventory-service
root_cause: Traffic spike exceeded the configured connection pool size, causing request queuing and timeouts.
recommended_action: Temporarily increase the connection pool size and add autoscaling alerts on pool utilization.

title: SMTP gateway timeouts after notification-service provider switch
root_cause: The new SMTP provider enforced stricter per-connection rate limits than the previous provider.
recommended_action: Add exponential backoff and request a rate-limit increase from the SMTP provider.

title: payments-gateway timeouts after fraud-check-service integration deploy
root_cause: A deploy lowered the fraud-check-service client timeout, causing legitimate slow responses from fraud-check-service to be treated as failures.
recommended_action: Roll back the fraud-check-service client timeout change, or raise it back while fraud-check-service's own latency is investigated separately.
